codeReview.summary: Implementation fully meets the feature requirements. The mobile month view was successfully rewritten using NativeWind v5 Tailwind classes with a 7-column grid, weekday headers, event dots, and correct styling for selected/current days. No hardcoded colors or StyleSheet.create were used.

summary: The calendar month view was successfully ported to use NativeWind v5 and adheres to all design requirements.
